$comment: Cross-references in the apidoc source that name something which does not exist.
Each is a bug in tidev/titanium-sdk, not in docgen. They are listed here so the
compile fails on NEW breakage while these stay visible; delete an entry as soon
as the upstream fix lands, and docgen will tell you when one is no longer hit.
Run `pnpm docgen ... --strict` to compile as if this file were empty.

refs.Global.Intl.NumberFormat.NumberFormatOpt: declared as the top-level pseudo-type NumberFormatOptions, not nested under NumberFormat
refs.Ti.Color: no such type; colors are plain Strings
refs.Titanium.App.Android.R.color: R is a dynamic resource namespace with no documented members
refs.Titanium.Geolocation.frequency: removed property, still referenced from Geolocation.Android
refs.Titanium.Media.allowMultiple: belongs to the options dictionaries, not the Media module
refs.Titanium.UI.TabGroup.disableTabOptions: the pseudo-type is disableTabOptions, not a TabGroup member
refs.Titanium.UI.iOS.createAlertDialog: AlertDialog lives in Titanium.UI, so the factory is Titanium.UI.createAlertDialog
